mentions.name: AI image-to-Gimp/FreeCAD building pipeline
mentions.description: This AI pipeline analyzes an input image and generates TinyScheme code to draw a 2D representation of it in Gimp, then uses Rust and FreeCAD with additional information to produce a 3D representation of a building.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am experimenting with using A.I. to see an image, and generate TinyScheme code to draw it on Gimp. As soon as I got the code for a 2D representation, then I bring out the heavy weaponry, Rust and Freecad, and with some more information added I generate the 3D representation of a building.
mentions.author: emporas
